parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the device label. If you pass in an empty string, the description is cleared. The description can contain letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: DeviceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the device label.

parameters.name: DynamicOperator
parameters.description: The rule operator of the dynamic device group.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the device label. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported. Spaces are not supported.
